content: If a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor must be used for a short duration (e.g., anti-infectives for ≤7 days), interrupt ibrutinib therapy until the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of idelalisib by altering hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administered with strong CYP3A inhibitors, monitor for signs of idelalisib toxicity and adjust the dosage if adverse reactions occur. Idelalisib also increases the levels or effects of darunavir via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Idelalisib is a strong CYP3A inhibitor; avoid co-administration with sensitive CYP3A substrates. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of infigratinib (DSC) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of ivosidenib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with ivosidenib or replace with alternative therapies. If unavoidable, reduce the ivosidenib dose to 250 mg daily. After discontinuing the strong inhibitor for at least 5 half-lives, increase the ivosidenib dose to the recommended 500 mg daily. Ivosidenib decreases the levels or effects of darunavir via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates with ivosidenib or replace with alternative therapies. If unavoidable, monitor for loss of therapeutic effect. Ketoconazole and darunavir increase each other's effects by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Specific dosage recommendations for ketoconazole with darunavir are unavailable. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of larotrectinib, lefamulin, lemborexant, and leniolisib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration of lefamulin with strong CYP3A inhibitors. Avoid co-administration of lemborexant with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of levoketoconazole via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Specific dosage recommendations for ketoconazole with darunavir are unavailable. Darunavir may alter the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives containing levonorgestrel, ethinyl estradiol, and ferrous bisglycinate due to changes in estrogen plasma levels. Use a nonhormonal contraceptive method. Lopinavir decreases darunavir levels by increasing metabolism but also increases darunavir effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lorlatinib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of lorlatinib with strong CYP3A inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the lorlatinib dose by 25 mg/day. After discontinuing the strong inhibitor for 3 plasma half-lives, resume the previous lorlatinib dose. Lorlatinib decreases darunavir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lovotibeglogene autotemcel by interfering with antiretroviral therapy (ART) manufacturing. Discontinue ARTs at least 1 month before mobilization and until all apheresis cycles are completed. Long-acting ARTs may require a longer discontinuation period. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lurbinectedin via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the lurbinectedin dose by 50%. After discontinuing the strong CYP3A inhibitor for 5 half-lives, resume the previous lurbinectedin dose. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of macitentan via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of macitentan with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Darunavir decreases the levels or effects of medroxyprogesterone via an unspecified mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of mefloquine via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration during and for 15 weeks after discontinuing mefloquine. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of metoclopramide intranasal via CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Concurrent use of metoclopramide intranasal with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors is not recommended since the dose cannot be adjusted. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of midazolam via CYP3A4 metabolism. Oral midazolam and triazolam are contraindicated with darunavir/ritonavir due to the risk of prolonged sedation or respiratory depression. Avoid or use an alternative drug for intranasal midazolam. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of midostaurin via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, monitor for increased adverse reactions, especially during the first week of treatment. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of modafinil, nefazodone, and neratinib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid co-administration of neratinib with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Nevirapine decreases darunavir levels via CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially leading to therapeutic failure and resistance. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of nirogacestat via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir decreases the levels or effects of norgestimate via an unspecified mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of olaparib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with moderate CYP3A inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the olaparib dose to 200 mg (capsule) or 150 mg (tablet) twice daily. Do not substitute tablets with capsules. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of omaveloxolone via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the omaveloxolone dose to 50 mg/day and monitor closely for adverse effects. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Co-administration of Viekira Pak with darunavir/ritonavir is not recommended. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of osimertinib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If no alternative exists, monitor closely for adverse effects. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of palbociclib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose to 75 mg/day. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of pazopanib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, reduce the pazopanib dose to 400 mg/day. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of pemigatinib via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose as per the drug monograph. After discontinuing the inhibitor for 3 elimination half-lives, resume the previous dose.
